items.title: Six Facebook-style reaction stickers on message thread
items.precondition: Signed in; open /messages/:id with at least one non-unsent message from peer
steps: Hover or hold the react control on a message bubble
Confirm picker shows six stickers: Like, Heart, Haha, Wow, Sad, Angry
Select Sad; confirm summary updates and peer sees it via socket/poll
items.expected: All six Messenger-equivalent Unicode stickers available; set/switch/clear works; summary cluster shows active types + total.
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: Implemented ReactionBar message target with six REACTION_OPTIONS; user verified compose icons during session.

items.title: Message reaction UX matches feed (hover/hold expand + labels)
items.precondition: Open message thread on desktop and on touch viewport
steps: Desktop: hover react trigger — picker expands inline with labels on hover
Touch: press-and-hold react trigger — picker expands
items.expected: Same expand/hold/label behavior as ReactionBar on Feed, sized for message bubbles (sm).
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: MessageBubbleRow delegates to shared ReactionBar size sm.

items.title: Composer emoji picker inserts multiple emoji into message text
steps: Click the emoji button beside the image attach control
Pick several emoji from the grid (e.g. 😀🔥🎉)
items.expected: Selected emoji append to textarea at cursor; sent message bubble renders the emoji characters as text.

items.title: Sad and Angry reactions work on posts/comments (shared enum)
items.precondition: Feed has a friend's post; migration applied
steps: Expand reaction picker on a post
Expand reaction picker on a comment — confirm six options
items.expected: Feed surfaces pick up new enum values; counts and viewer state correct.
items.notes: Shared REACTION_EMOJIS + reactionOptions extended to six.
items.waiver: Post/comment angry reaction not manually clicked in session; code path identical to existing four.

items.title: API rejects unknown reaction keys
items.evidence: Zod z.enum(REACTION_EMOJIS) unchanged pattern in MessageService.

items.title: Typecheck and build green
steps: npm run typecheck (or project equivalent) in backend and frontend
items.expected: No type errors from ReactionEmoji union expansion or ReactionBar message target.
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: npm run typecheck && npm run build exit 0.
